notice: Schemas from actual Data V1 models; complement OpenAPI data fields typed Any.

MorphoMarketFields.description:
Morpho Blue market. Params are required: a market without params is not created.

Token amounts are in whole token units (raw / 10**decimals); raw values kept alongside.
MorphoMarketFields.title: MorphoMarketFields

OraclePriceDTO.description:
Morpho oracle price: collateral (base) quoted in loan token (quote).

value == raw_value / 10**scale_exponent,
scale_exponent == 36 + loan_decimals - collateral_decimals.
OraclePriceDTO.title: OraclePriceDTO

PendleMarketFields.description: Pendle V2 market: PT/YT/SY triple, expiry and API metrics.
PendleMarketFields.title: PendleMarketFields

TokenRef.description: Token identified by (chain_id, address). `symbol` is a label only.
TokenRef.title: TokenRef

VerificationCheckDTO.description:
API-claimed value vs value read on-chain for one essential relationship.

Values are canonical strings (normalised address, bytes32, integer string).
A mismatch keeps both values; nothing is silently resolved.
VerificationCheckDTO.title: VerificationCheckDTO

MarketDTO.description:
Normalised market. Exactly one protocol block is set, matching `protocol`.

market_id: bytes32 id for Morpho Blue, market contract address for Pendle.
